HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Which statement about Modern Nationalism in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Modern Nationalism in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Modern Nationalism in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Modern Nationalism in Africa.

3. Which statement about Linguistic groups in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Linguistic groups in Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Say Linguistic groups in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Linguistic groups in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Linguistic groups in Kenya.

4. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

6. Which statement about African Civilisations up to 19th Century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations up to 19th Century.
   B. Say African Civilisations up to 19th Century never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat African Civilisations up to 19th Century as rumours only.

7. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

8. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.
   D. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.

9. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat National integration as rumours only.
   B. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.

10. Which statement about Elections in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Elections in Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Say Elections in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Elections in Kenya.
   D. Explain Elections in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.
   B. Say Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence.

12. Which statement about Colonization of Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Colonization of Africa.
   B. Say Colonization of Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Colonization of Africa as rumours only.

13. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Introduction to History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   C. Say Introduction to History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to History and Citizenship.

14. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   B. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.

15. Which statement about Public Participation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Public Participation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Public Participation as rumours only.
   C. Explain Public Participation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Participation.

16. Which statement about Global Wars is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Global Wars never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Global Wars.
   D. Treat Global Wars as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Elections in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain National integration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Human Developments in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Colonization of Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Modern Nationalism in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
